Wildfire v1.0.1, December 7, 2021

Wildfire is an infection themed-video game developed in 30 hours for Eric Weng's high-school senior project.
To download the latest releases, visit https://github.com/SlavSquatSuperstar/wildfire-game-java/releases

This app was created with Java using the Greenfoot Platform and ported to Gradle.
Exporting was made possible by Benoit Heinrich's Greenfoot Runner repository.

How to Run
- Download Java JRE 11 at https://adoptium.net/ and select your operating system and architecture.
- Read "How to Play.pdf" for game instructions
- Double-click on the .jar file or run "java -jar (filename)" with it to launch the game

Resources
- Greenfoot: https://greenfoot.org/door
- Greenfoot Runner: https://github.com/benoitheinrich/greenfoot-runner
